title: Milton Friedman Speaks: Money and Inflation (B1230) - Full Video
summary: An 86-minute Milton Friedman talk arguing that inflation is a monetary phenomenon caused by money supply growing faster than goods, and that the cure is less government spending and money printing.
why: Shared during inflation discussions as an accessible, layman-friendly statement of the monetarist view.

quote.text: I think is under rated talk which explains complex stuff in layman terms.
